ogeler.metin: Automatically collected through Firebase Analytics:
App usage statistics (which screens were opened)
Device type and operating system version
App version
Anonymous user ID
Stored on your device and included in the cloud backup:
Favorite verses
Personal notes
Quran completion tracking and reading position (bookmark)
Lesson and Arabic alphabet learning progress
Daily streak information
Some app preferences (night mode, font size, tajweed)
This data is primarily stored on your device. The relevant verse keys may be sent to the app API to display the translations and verse information for verses you have favorited or added notes to.

parcalar.metin: The data above is backed up using Google Firebase (Cloud Firestore) so that your progress is not lost if you uninstall and reinstall the app or switch to a new device. This backup is linked to an anonymous identity (Firebase Anonymous Authentication) created without requesting any identifying information such as your name, email address, or phone number. Access to your backup is restricted by security rules to your anonymous identity alone; data is encrypted in transit using HTTPS. Backup content, including your note text, is not used for advertising, profiling, or analytics and is not shared with third parties. You can permanently delete your backup and anonymous account from within the app at any time (see "7. Account and Data Deletion").

If your device's system backup feature is enabled, this on-device data may also be backed up automatically: to the Google Drive account linked to your device on Android, or to your iCloud account on iOS. This backup is managed by Google or Apple and can be turned off in your device settings.

Approximate location (at the city level) is used for prayer times and the qibla direction; precise (GPS) location is not used. The qibla direction is calculated entirely on your device. For prayer times, your location is rounded to roughly 1 km and sent to our app server, which uses it only to find the nearest city of the Presidency of Religious Affairs of Türkiye (Diyanet) and then fetches that city's times from Diyanet (your location is not sent to Diyanet). If this service is unavailable or there is no Diyanet city near you, your approximate location is sent to the third-party service Aladhan.com instead. Your location is not recorded on our servers; it may only appear temporarily in the standard, short-lived request logs of our hosting provider (Vercel). The matched city and prayer times are stored on your device.

When you use the search feature in the app, your search query may be sent to the app server solely to retrieve search results. Search queries are not used for ad targeting or user profiling; search text is not sent to Firebase Analytics.
The app does not contain ads and does not collect your advertising ID.
The app does not request microphone access or record audio.

ogeler.metin: The data collected is used only for the following purposes:
Improving app performance
Detecting and fixing errors
Improving the user experience

parcalar.metin: Your data is never sold to third parties.

ogeler.metin: The app uses the following third-party services:
Firebase Analytics — Usage statistics
Firebase Authentication — Anonymous identity for linking the cloud backup specifically to you
Cloud Firestore — Cloud backup storage
Sentry — Error reporting
Diyanet (Presidency of Religious Affairs of Türkiye) — Prayer times (per city; your location is not sent)
Aladhan.com — Fallback prayer times API
Vercel — App server (hosting)
Turso — Database
All API communications are encrypted using HTTPS
No user account is required; names, email addresses, and phone numbers are not collected
Your note text is stored on your device and only in your personal cloud backup, which is protected by an anonymous identity; it is not used for any other purpose
Verse keys for favorited verses or verses with notes may be sent to the API only to display the relevant verse information
The app is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from users under 13.
You have the following rights under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK):
The right to access your data
The right to request correction of your data
The right to request deletion of your data
